svg.text: Goal: Move the next-generation optical module from concept review to controlled customer pilot.

g.text: Confirm customer requirements, target cost, and performance
Lock optical engine, driver architecture, and package
Build engineering samples and close first assembly issues
Review yield, optical margin, firmware stability, and open
Approve pilot quantity, containment plan, and customer
Ship pilot units and monitor field link stability
Decide controlled launch based on pilot yield and
- Gate decisions should be based on yield,
